About the Program

The QLP Program is a voluntary program in which issuers of eligible Nasdaq-listed ETPs may elect to pay a Premier Annual Listing Fee. One registered Nasdaq market maker (QLP) is assigned to each participating ETP and is expected to meet specified quoting and liquidity standards.

The QLP Program supports quoting and liquidity activity that may not otherwise exist absent participation in the program. Participation is voluntary and may end at any time. When an ETP exits the QLP Program, its market maker will continue to provide liquidity under the Exchange's DLP Program, though the applicable quoting and depth standards may differ. Investors should be aware that market conditions in a participating ETP may change over time.

For more information, contact ETFS@nasdaq.com.
